output.subject: Your question about notary service at our Lantern Hill branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us. You asked whether our Lantern Hill branch still has a notary available. You mentioned that you need a car title signed and would prefer not to make the drive into the city to get it done. That makes complete sense, and we'd like to get you a clear answer.

We've passed your question to our Branch & Contact Center team, who will check what is currently available at Lantern Hill and get back to you with the details. You can expect a response from us within 10 business days.

If your plans change in the meantime, or if there's anything else you'd like us to know about what you need for the car title, just reply to this message and we'll make sure the team has it.

Thank you again for reaching out, and for giving us the chance to help.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a question, not a complaint; consider whether it should be handled outside the complaints process.
Confirm whether the Lantern Hill branch currently offers notary services before replying with an answer.
If notary service is available, decide whether to add hours, appointment requirements, any fees, and what the customer should bring for a vehicle title.
If not available, decide whether to suggest the nearest alternative location.
The customer may need this soon; consider whether a faster answer than 10 business days is possible.
